items.title: AlphaGenome Atlas: predictive map of every possible DNA letter change
items.title_zh: DeepMind发布AlphaGenome Atlas：近90亿单碱基变异效应预计算图谱
items.summary_zh: 谷歌DeepMind推出AlphaGenome Atlas，对人类基因组约90亿种可能的单核苷酸变异预计算调控影响，数据集约1PB，并引入综合编码/非编码效应的AVI分数，供临床与复杂性状研究快速排序候选位点。门户对非商业研究免费开放，商业用途拟上云；Broad等团队已用其辅助未解罕见病与BMI相关非编码关联挖掘。

quotes.author: Google DeepMind
quotes.en: We used the AlphaGenome AI model to pre-calculate the regulatory impact of all 9 billion single-letter genetic changes, resulting in a massive, 1-petabyte dataset.
quotes.zh: 我们使用AlphaGenome人工智能模型预计算全部90亿种单字母基因改变的调控影响，形成约1PB的庞大数据集。

items.title: I've factored the RSA keys of a Certificate Authority from the 90s
items.title_zh: 我分解了1990年代某证书颁发机构的RSA密钥
items.summary_zh: 作者展示对上世纪90年代某 CA 的 RSA 密钥完成因式分解，HN 约480赞。前 Netscape 根证书产品经理现身回忆；亦有评论惋惜过多细节交给 AI 代写，追问自制 TLS 实现的原因。

quotes.author: hnmullany
quotes.en: I was the product manager with responsibility for root certificates in the Netscape 4.51 browser. It's crazy to see someone factor it 25 years later. Just to reply to some people in the comments. Yes, we knew export grade encryption was weak - that was the point - that the NSA could decrypt it - and the govt. required us to do it anyway. FWIW - we had the goal of expanding the list of root authorities in the 4.5x release - and this might have been the first release to monetize the root slots bec
quotes.zh: 我曾是 Netscape 4.51 浏览器根证书相关产品经理。二十五年后看有人把它因式分解，感觉很疯狂。也回应评论区一些点：是的……

quotes.en: A bit unfortunate that so many of the interesting bits were left to ai. I would've enjoyed some commentary on why the custom TLS implementation was necessary. Oh well. Update: found this explanation in a comment at the top of the (surprisingly short) Go file in the linked repo: The target client is Netscape Communicator 4.51 (both the 40-bit export build and the 128-bit US build) with its clock set to the year 2000. Go's crypto/tls cannot help: it dropped SSLv3 in Go 1.14, never accepted th
quotes.zh: 有点遗憾许多有趣部分交给了 AI。我本来想看更多关于为何必须自制 TLS 实现的说明。更新：后来找到了作者的解释。

items.title: Mistral raises €3B Series D at more than €21B valuation, Samsung-led
items.title_zh: Mistral完成30亿欧元D轮：估值超210亿，三星领投
items.summary_zh: 法国AI公司Mistral宣布30亿欧元D轮、投后估值超210亿欧元，称欧洲科技史上最大股权融资；三星电子领投，EQT管理的Scaleup Europe Fund与PSG Equity联席，BlackRock、卢森堡大公国等新进，ASML、NVIDIA等跟投。资金将扩前沿研究、训练算力与主权开源权重栈，服务空客、ASML、汇丰等百余家企业客户。

quotes.author: Arthur Mensch / Mistral
quotes.en: This round means we can move faster on R&D, products, infrastructure and keep giving organisations the ability to run AI at scale, on their own terms.
quotes.zh: 本轮融资意味着我们能在研发、产品与基础设施上加速，并继续让各组织按自己的条件大规模运行AI。

items.title: DaVinci Resolve 21.1
items.title_zh: DaVinci Resolve 21.1：黑魔法再推剪辑更新
items.summary_zh: Blackmagic 发布 Resolve 21.1，HN 约340赞。老用户称免费升级、无订阅模式仍稀缺；Linux 用户抱怨缺少高效的 H.264/AAC 支持，影响磁盘与剪辑流畅度。

quotes.author: neovive
quotes.en: I've been using it for many years, and it's grown in power and functionality with every release. BMD has offered free upgrades to Pro users (with no subscription) for many years, which is refreshing given the current state of software licensing. For those upset with the new agent integration, keep in mind that one of the big knocks on DaVinci Resolve is that it's hard for beginners. Powerful tools like color grading and nodes take years to truly master (and that won't change), but making it easi
quotes.zh: 我用了好多年，每个版本都更强。BMD 长期给 Pro 用户免费升级、不搞订阅，在这个行业里难得。

quotes.author: nickjj
quotes.en: I really wish the Linux version supported h264 video and AAC audio. These are extremely disk space efficient codecs and even on 12 year old hardware you can edit 1080p videos without any CPU bound lag. Having to re-encode your source material and re-encode your exports is too tedious to do in practice. On Windows I edited 100+ podcasts with Resolve and it's so good. Video editing on Linux for the last 9 months with Kdenlive has been killing me (vs Camtasia or Resolve on Windows).
quotes.zh: 真希望 Linux 版支持 H.264 视频和 AAC 音频。这些编码特别省盘，即便十二年老硬件剪 1080p 也不会轻易 CPU 打满卡死。

items.title: EU wants initial Chinese action on trade gap by early October
items.title_zh: 欧盟敦促中国在十月初前对贸易顺差采取初步行动
items.summary_zh: 欧盟贸易委员谢夫乔维奇表示，希望与中方对话在十月初前拿出初步行动，以应对2025年对欧顺差约3606亿欧元、2026上半年再扩9%的失衡，议题含出口激增、欧企准入与关键矿产出口管制。工业界警告若不遏制供应链被中国组件商挤压，欧盟制造业年内或再失约30万岗位；保障措施与钢铝关税已成备手。

quotes.author: Maros Sefcovic / Reuters
quotes.en: The European Commission will seek commitments from China to work on tackling a widening trade gap with the European Union and for Beijing to take some initial action by early October.
quotes.zh: 欧盟委员会将寻求中方承诺着手应对不断扩大的对欧贸易顺差，并在十月初前采取一些初步行动。

items.title: Paramount Caught Using 'Astroturf' Group to Drum Up Fake Support for Merger
items.title_zh: Paramount被指用伪草根组织为千亿美元合并造势
items.summary_zh: Neighbors for Strong Communities 等新组织借助 AI 写信工具向加州总检察长施压，试图动摇对 Paramount–华纳兄弟探索合并的反垄断诉讼；捐赠不透明引发 astroturf 指控，HN 约320赞。

quotes.author: MarioMan
quotes.en: Several years ago, Paramount was handing out free monthly trial codes for Paramount Plus every month. Then, some time in 2020, they just ”forgot” to cut off my access after the trial ended. I had free Paramount Plus from then until 2025, when they merged with Skydance. The free subscription expired almost immediately after the merger was announced. It’s evident to me now that they did this to boost their active subscriber numbers. I’m sure a lot of people didn’t even realize this had happened to
quotes.zh: 好几年前 Paramount 几乎每月发 Paramount+ 免费试用码。然后大概2020年某时，他们好像“忘了”在试用结束后切断我的访问……

quotes.author: piloto_ciego
quotes.en: Man... I am wondering how much of everything this is these days... This is just one instance, but the propaganda effect I think is happening strong. I think probably all of public opinion is being manipulated like this...
quotes.zh: 天啊……我在想如今有多少事情都是这样。这只是一例，但宣传/舆论操纵效应我觉得非常强。大概公共讨论的很多面向都被这种东西渗透了。

items.title: Oil nears $100 after Houthi strikes on Saudi energy infrastructure
items.title_zh: 胡塞打沙特能源设施后油价逼近100美元，高盛提示120风险
items.summary_zh: 布伦特一度触及约99.5美元/桶，为数周高位；WTI同步大涨。分析指向霍尔木兹流量低迷叠加红海—曼德海峡受胡塞威胁，沙特更多依赖红海出口却暴露于新打击面。高盛与汇丰称若海湾出口持续受限，布伦特或冲向约120美元，库存逼近操作低位。

quotes.author: Goldman Sachs
quotes.en: If Persian Gulf oil flows remain low, Brent might exceed $120.
quotes.zh: 若波斯湾石油流量持续偏低，布伦特或将超过120美元。

items.title: Kimi K3 (2.8T) at 1 token/s on a MacBook Pro, streamed from four SSDs
items.title_zh: Kimi K3（2.8T）在MacBook Pro上1 token/s：四块SSD流式加载
items.summary_zh: 项目展示在MacBook Pro上借助四块SSD流式加载，以约1 token/s运行参数量约2.8T的Kimi K3；HN约200赞。评论联想《银河系漫游指南》深思电脑，并吐槽苹果架构无法加内存、只好堆外置存储——“640KB该够用了”的当代回声。

quotes.author: lukeduff
quotes.en: Reminds me of Deep Thought from Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
quotes.zh: 让我想起《银河系漫游指南》里的深思电脑。

quotes.author: amelius
quotes.en: The SSDs are necessary because Apple's architecture doesn't allow RAM upgrades. Reminds me of someone who said "640KB ought to be enough for anybody".
quotes.zh: 之所以需要SSD，是因为苹果架构不允许升级内存。让我想起有人说过“640KB对任何人来说都该够了”。

items.title: EU faces 300,000 factory job cuts as China 'colonises' supply chains, industry warns
items.title_zh: 欧工业组织警告：中国组件扩张或致30万工厂岗位流失
items.summary_zh: 行业协会Eurometal警告，若布鲁塞尔不能遏制中国组件商对欧供应链的扩张，2026年余下时间欧盟制造业可能再失去约30万岗位；中国对欧贸易顺差已达约每日10亿欧元量级。团体在欧委会周边象征性抬棺抗议，呼吁更快动用保障措施与关税工具。

quotes.author: The Guardian / Eurometal
quotes.en: Job losses in EU manufacturing will rapidly increase unless Brussels stops the “colonisation” of industry by Chinese component manufacturers.
quotes.zh: 除非布鲁塞尔制止中国组件制造商对工业的“殖民”，否则欧盟制造业岗位流失将迅速加剧。

items.title: I-have-ADHD: A skill to stop coding agents from burying the answer
items.title_zh: I-have-ADHD：让编程智能体先给结论的技能文件
items.summary_zh: GitHub 项目用 skill 约束编码代理先答后展，缓解长文埋重点；HN 约295赞，讨论 skills 作为人机合约层的价值与“Claude病”治理。

quotes.author: jp57
quotes.en: Let's face it. Claude (in particular) is a terrible writer. There's a whole cottage industry of skills and CLAUDE.md instructions trying to push it toward writing better, but each new model iteration seems expressly designed to override all that so that it can load up its writing with unnecessary participle phrases, not-this-but-thats, burying the lede, and other nonsense. I genuinely wonder if the people inside Anthropic actually communicate with each other like that. Has it been imprinted with
quotes.zh: 说实话，Claude（尤其是它）文笔很糟。已经有一整cottage industry的 skills 和 CLAUDE.md 试图把它往好文章上推，但每一次……

quotes.author: ryandrake
quotes.en: The biggest "Claudism" that I have a hard time getting the LLM to stop doing is its insistence on talking about what it didn't do in addition to what it did. "I edited this.py and that.py but I did not edit README.md and I did not commit." or code comments like "This code invokes foo on bar and returns the results directly -- not through a callback." "This code returns true if the user clicked on a button -- not on the list view." I mean, thanks, Claude, but I don't care what the code doesn't do
quotes.zh: 我最难改掉的“Claude病”，是它坚持既说做了什么、又大段说没做什么：“我改了 this.py，并且没有……”——请直接给结论。
